purpose: Proposed semantic decisions for call graph projection

decisions.statement: An edge is STATIC_RESOLUTION if the target callable is deterministically resolvable from source code syntax (direct imports, named references)
An edge is RUNTIME_RESOLUTION if the target requires execution context (callbacks, factory results, dynamic requires)
An edge is UNRESOLVED if it cannot be classified as static or runtime; it receives an explicit UNRESOLVED_EDGE disposition
Cycles are permitted in the result; each edge appears once with its forward direction; bidirectional edges appear twice
A reachability slice includes all nodes reachable from the entry point via zero or more edges, recursively

resolutionStrategy.dependencyHandling: include external dependencies at module boundary
resolutionStrategy.cycleBehavior: traverse cycles, record edge once per direction

failureHandling.handlingStrategy: Report entry point not found; list available CLI entry points
Detect at traversal time; mark edges as cycle participants; continue traversal
Respect optional depth limit; mark deeper nodes as DEPTH_LIMIT_REACHED

edgeClassifications.UNRESOLVED_EDGE: Cannot be classified; explicit disposition recorded
